cases.name: all core references populated
cases.env:
EE_ENVIRONMENT=development
EE_APP_NAME=Elder Engage Local
EE_API_PREFIX=/v1
EE_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
EE_GCP_PROJECT_ID=example-development-project
EE_GCP_REGION=asia-south1
EE_PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8000
EE_TRUSTED_HOSTS=127.0.0.1,localhost,testserver
EE_CORS_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:3000
EE_CLOUD_SQL_INSTANCE=example-development-project:asia-south1:example-postgres
EE_DATABASE_URL_SECRET_REF=projects/example-development-project/secrets/ee-database-url/versions/latest
EE_RATE_LIMIT_STORE=memory
EE_REDIS_URL_SECRET_REF=
EE_SESSION_SIGNING_KEY_SECRET_REF=projects/example-development-project/secrets/ee-session-signing-key/versions/latest
EE_REFRESH_TOKEN_PEPPER_SECRET_REF=projects/example-development-project/secrets/ee-refresh-token-pepper/versions/latest
EE_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_SECRET_REF=projects/example-development-project/secrets/ee-field-encryption-key/versions/latest
EE_MEMBER_IDENTITY_PROVIDER=mock
EE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=
EE_MEMBER_TOKEN_AUDIENCE=
EE_UPLOADS_BUCKET=example-development-quarantine
EE_APPROVED_MEDIA_BUCKET=example-development-approved-media
EE_UPLOAD_SIGNER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT=ee-upload-signer@example-development-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
EE_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES=10485760
EE_UPLOAD_ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES=video/mp4
EE_UPLOAD_AUTHORIZATION_SECONDS=300
EE_FCM_ENABLED=false
EE_FCM_PROJECT_ID=
EE_YOUTUBE_ENABLED=false
EE_YOUTUBE_API_KEY_SECRET_REF=
EE_MEET_MODE=disabled
EE_MEET_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_REF=
EE_BROADCAST_PROVIDER=disabled
EE_AGORA_APP_ID=
EE_AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE_SECRET_REF=
EE_ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES=10
EE_REFRESH_TOKEN_DAYS=30
